copy.title: Waiting to Start
copy.headline: How long have these tickets been waiting to get started?
copy.lede: Every open issue sitting in Todo/Ready on the dev board. Grooming is done, but no developer has picked the work up yet. Each ticket is aged from the moment it last moved into that column.
copy.chart_title: Distribution of time waiting to start
notes: **Age here reads differently than in QA.** A ticket waiting to start is competing for capacity against everything else in the column, so a long tail is expected. What is worth looking at is the shape: a wide spread suggests the column is being picked from by priority, while a long flat tail suggests tickets that keep losing that competition.
